sentences.text: 4. Learned advocate for the applicant would submit that considering the role attributed to the applicant, and nature of the allegation levelled, the applicant may be enlarged on regular bail.
It is further submitted that since the charge-sheet is filed no useful purpose would be served by keeping the applicant in jail for indefinite period.
It is further contended that the applicant is ready and willing to abide by all the conditions that may be imposed by this Court if released on bail.
5. As against the same, learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent - State has vehemently objected to the grant of regular bail.

Learned APP has submitted that looking to the nature of offence and the role attributed to the present applicant as coming out from the charge-sheet, this Court may not exercise the discretion in favour of the applicant and the application may be dismissed.
NEUTRAL
CITATION
R/CR.MA/7075/2026 ORDER DATED: 02/04/2026 undefined 6.
I have heard learned advocates appearing on behalf of the respective parties and perused the papers.

Following aspects are considered:-
i. Allegation being that the accused having floated a investment Company had defrauded the investors by not returning the amount which had been deposited.
ii.
The allegation against the present applicant being that he was one of the Directors of the Company.

iii. While it is attempted to be submitted by learned advocate Mr.Dave that the applicant had resigned yet, the resignation appears to be of the year 2017, whereas the period of offence is shown to be from 2012 to 2017.

iv. Having observed as herein above, it is also pertinent to note that the main accused, the Managing Director of the Company has been enlarged on regular bail by learned Co- ordinate Bench vide order dated 24.08.2023 and other accused, having similar role have also been released.
v.

While it appears that the applicant had remained absconding and whereas warrant under Section 70 had also been issued yet, it also does not appear that the applicant,
had absconded during the period, more particularly since it appears that the present applicant was residing at the very place as per the address shown in the warrant.
NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/7075/2026 ORDER DATED: 02/04/2026 undefined vi.

It also appears that there are five FIRs lodged against the present applicant yet, it would also appear that the FIRs are registered against the Company in question i.e. the other accused including the main accused having also been arraigned.

sentences.text: Considering the above, and also having regard to the fact that the applicant is in custody since 18.11.2025 and charge-sheet qua the applicant is filed, this Court is inclined to grant bail.

This Court has taken into consideration the law laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Sanjay Chandra v. Central Bureau of Investigation reported in [2012] 1 SCC 40.
7.

entities.text: Sanjay Chandra v. Central Bureau of Investigation reported in [2012] 1 SCC 40
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
In the facts and circumstances of the case and considering the nature of the allegations made against the applicant in the First Information Report, without discussing the evidence in detail,
prima facie, this Court is of the opinion that this is a fit case to exercise the discretion and enlarge the applicant on regular bail.
8. Hence, the present application is allowed.

If breach of any of the above conditions is committed, the Sessions Court concerned will be free to take appropriate action in the matter.
10. Bail bond to be executed before the lower court having jurisdiction to try the case.
It will be open for the concerned Court to delete, modify and/or relax any of the above conditions in accordance with law.
